name: makefile-recipe-entry
description: The recipe lines of the target root's makefile are read as command strings, each line up to its shell comment, and a cd command moves the directory the later commands of its line are read against, so a file a recipe runs or names is rooted. The makefile's whole text is held as well, so a file only a recipe's comment names is held, nothing it exports is reported, and the package has one note.
